newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar firms in consolidation after falls.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar firms in consolidation after falls.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures firmed, with the active nearby months extending their earlier small gains.
"I think it's just been another day of consolidation, after last week's falls" one trader said.
By 1655 GMT, active March was up $2.10 at $297.70. March dominated volume, with 1,322 out of 1,625 lots traded by that point.
Much of the volume had been in trades against actuals, the trader said. Overall, he described London as quiet.
New York had helped, heading higher in follow through to Friday's gains, but London traders saw it becoming a bearish element if March does not breach resistance at 10.47 cents.
In physical news, the European Union's sugar management committee will discuss the final sugar balance sheet for 1995/96 on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
"The committee will also discuss the provisional balance sheet for 1996/97," the official said.
Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha was quoted by Interfax news agency as saying on Monday that the cabinet had proposed imposing quotas on refined sugar imports.
